_schema.description: xevoSigma PREMIUM Custom Residence - Single Source of Truth (SSOT).
contract: EVERY dimensional value in this project MUST originate here.
No script, no .blend file and no Unreal asset may hard-code a building dimension.
Each entry carries a `status` field. Legal values:
CONFIRMED  - directly readable from a supplied drawing, or stated by the client.
DERIVED    - computed from CONFIRMED values by an explicit, documented rule.
ASSUMED    - not in any drawing; a placeholder chosen by the ArchViz team.
UNRESOLVED - required, not yet known, and NOT safe to guess. Blocks completion.
A build performed while any UNRESOLVED entry is reachable from the geometry graph
produces a PLACEHOLDER MASSING, never a digital twin. qa_verify.py enforces this.

unit_policy.note: 1 Blender Unit = 1 m. Unreal import scale 100 (1 uu = 1 cm). No exceptions.

project.name: xevoSigma PREMIUM Custom Residence Digital Twin

drawing_set_received.source: session inspection 2026-09-06: /mnt/attach empty, repository contains no drawing files
drawing_set_received.note: The brief refers to attached site plan / 1F plan / 2F plan / elevations / sections. NONE were delivered to this session. See docs/DRAWING_ANALYSIS.md.

model_state.note: Becomes CANDIDATE_TWIN only when every UNRESOLVED entry below is filled from the drawing set.

jo_to_sqm.source: 1 tatami = 910 x 1820 mm (kyoma-han / metric module) = 1.6562 m2
jo_to_sqm.note: AMBIGUITY - Japanese house-maker plans quote 'jo' under at least two conventions: 1.6562 m2 (910x1820 module) and 1.62 m2 (the minimum permitted by the Fair Competition Code on real-estate advertising, Enforcement Rules Art.10). 17.3 jo therefore means 28.65 m2 OR 28.03 m2, a 0.6 m2 spread. Confirm which convention the Daiwa House plan uses before treating any music-room area as fixed.

planning_module.note: Half-ken metric module. xevoSigma is a steel-frame system on a grid; the actual module (455 / 910 / 1000 mm) MUST be read off the plan. All grid snapping in the build scripts uses this value.

road_side.note: north/south/east/west - drives privacy strategy and facade hierarchy

true_north_deg.note: REQUIRED before any sun study is meaningful (section Q)

gl_to_1fl_m.note: GL to 1st floor level. Typical 0.40-0.60 m; NOT assumed.

placeholder.note: Used ONLY to keep the placeholder massing buildable. Never render as fact.

structure.note: xevoSigma is Daiwa House's steel-frame line; confirm on the drawing title block.

placeholder.note: Rectangular stand-in only. The real footprint is almost certainly articulated.

ceiling_h_1f_m.note: xevoSigma marketing promotes a 2720 mm ceiling grade. That is a PRODUCT OPTION, not a fact about this house. Do not model 2.72 m until the section confirms it.

eaves_projection_m.note: 'Deep eaves' is a stated design intent (section H) but the projection is a drawing value.

music_room._priority: CRITICAL - see docs/PIANO_ROOM_REQUIREMENTS.md. This room may not be modelled as a generic bedroom, guest room, western-style room or multi-purpose room under any circumstance.

plan_area_jo.source: client brief section B (as annotated on the Daiwa House plan)

plan_area_m2.note: 28.03 m2 under the 1.62 m2/jo convention. Both carried until the convention is confirmed.

gross_internal_x_m.note: Area alone does not fix the shape. A 28.65 m2 room can be 5.46x5.25 or 7.28x3.94 - the second cannot hold two grand pianos. THE ASPECT RATIO IS THE DECIDING VARIABLE.

acoustic_construction._status_note: ASSUMED throughout. No acoustic specification has been supplied. These are typical residential piano-room build-ups used to bound the net-area problem, NOT a specification.

target_grade.note: Typical residential grand-piano room target. Dr-45 is often sold as 'piano-capable' but is marginal for two grands.

wall_buildup_per_side_m.note: Independent inner stud wall + air gap + absorbent + 2x plasterboard, measured from the finished face of the base construction.

clear_width_m.note: TYPICAL FOR AN ACOUSTIC DOOR AND A KNOWN PROBLEM - see delivery_access below.

airlock_vestibule.note: A two-door airlock raises isolation but consumes ~1.6-2.5 m2 of the 28.65 m2.

hvac.value: dedicated wall-mounted or ducted unit, isolated penetrations

delivery_access.note: A grand piano is moved on its bass side on a skid: approx L long x 0.50 m thick x (case width + skid) tall. It cannot be reduced further. An acoustic door of 750 mm clear width is a plausible show-stopper for a 1490-1580 mm wide instrument on its side.

required_clear_width_m.note: practical minimum quoted by piano movers

turning_space_required.note: A 2.0-2.8 m long rigid object must be able to turn from the approach route into the room opening.

resolution_options: Removable acoustic wall panel used once at installation
Full-height sliding sash (hakidashi-mado) to the garden as the delivery route
Install both instruments before the acoustic lining is closed up (sequencing constraint on the builder)

piano_A.note: Client has not nominated instruments. Semi-concert selected as the realistic upper bound for a residential room.

wall_to_piano.note: tuning/moving access and rim breathing room; acoustics also disfavour a hard-tight rim

between_pianos.note: shared circulation between the two instruments

player_zone_depth.note: bench (0.36) + seated player + ability to stand and leave

player_zone_width.note: wider than the 1.22 m playing width of 88 keys

placeholder.note: Used only by build_house.py --placeholder. This is the best-behaved candidate from the Phase 6 study (docs/PIANO_FIT_REPORT.md §6.2): a 10 x 14 bay room on the assumed 455 mm module, which has both the largest net floor area and the fewest degenerate axial modes of the shapes tested. It is a PROBE so that the pipeline can be exercised end-to-end — it is not a claim about the real room.

interior_proposal._status: PROPOSAL - NOT A SPECIFICATION (client brief section E)
interior_proposal.concept: Luxury Residential Music Salon - not a studio.
elements: reflective front wall, absorptive rear wall

rooms.note: Populated into docs/ROOM_SCHEDULE.csv on drawing receipt. Only the music room is known today.

openings.note: Populated into docs/OPENING_SCHEDULE.csv on drawing receipt.

polygon_m.source_required: 2F plan (void outline) cross-checked against the section

void.note: The vertical relationship 1F LDK -> void -> 2F must be resolved from the SECTION, not inferred from the plans (client brief section G).

stair.note: Building Standards Act Enforcement Order Art.23 sets minima for dwellings (tread >= 150 mm, riser <= 230 mm, width >= 750 mm). Those are legal FLOORS, not this house's dimensions - qa_verify.py checks the drawing values against them, it does not substitute them.

landscape._status: DESIGN PROPOSAL / CONCEPT MODEL (client brief section I). Explicitly NOT a specification.

B.name: Planting + water feature
B.note: client brief section K - alternative only

landscape.planting_policy: Japanese residential species; framed views from inside outward; never dense enough to hide the building (client brief section J).

latitude_deg.note: REQUIRED for a physically correct sun path.

eye_height_m.note: Standing eye height, adult in Japan (~1.70 m stature). User-adjustable at runtime per client brief section O.

seated_eye_height_m.note: Sofa-seated viewpoint required by client brief section A.
